name: Mera
description: Mera derives keys from a passkey (WebAuthn PRF), with no seed phrase and nothing secret stored. Your passkey signs you in to Lexari and derives a separate EVM key for each agent, so one Face ID or Touch ID covers all of them. Add it in Settings, Security.

actions.text: A separate key for each agent from one passkey
Same keys on every device your passkey syncs to
